questions.question: A can do a work in 8 days, B can do the same work in 10 days and C can do the same work in 12 days. If all three of them do the same work together and they are paid Rs. 7400, then what is the share (in Rs.) of B?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A can do a work in 8 days.

B can do the same work in 10 days.

C can do the same work in 12 days.

All three of them do the same work together and they are paid Rs. 7400.

**Formula used:**

W = E × T Where, W = Work, E = Efficiency, and T = Time

**Calculation:**

Let the total work be a units

Work done by A in 1 day = a/8

Work done by B in 1 day = a/10

Work done by C in 1 day = a/12

Ratio of work done by A, B and C:

⇒ A : B : C = 1/8 : 1/10 : 1/12

⇒ A : B : C = 15 : 12 : 10

Total amount paid to them = Rs. 7400

Share of B = Rs. 7400 × (12)/(15 + 12 + 10)

Share of B = Rs. 7400 × (12)/(37)

Share of B = Rs. 2400

**∴ The share (in Rs.) of B is 2400.**

questions.question: If x + 1/x = 17, then what is the value of frac{{{x⁴} + (1)/({{x²)}}}}{{{x²} - 3x + 1}}?
questions.solution:
Given: x + 1/x = 17

We know that: (x + 1/x)³ = x³ + (1/x)³ + 3(x)(1/x) (x + 1/x)

⇒ x³ + (1/x)³ = (x + 1/x)³ – 3(x + 1/x)

⇒ x³ + (1/x)³ = 17³ – 3(17)

⇒ x³ + (1/x)³ = 4862

To find: [x⁴ + (1/x²)]/x² - 3x + 1

Taking x common from both numerator and denominator, we get

⇒ x [x³ + (1/x)³]/x[x + 1/x – 3]

Substituting values

⇒ 4862/(17 – 3)

⇒ 4862/14 = 2431/7

∴ the correct option is 1)

questions.question: The average runs conceded by a bowler in 5 matches is 45 and 15.75 in other 4 matches. What is the average runs conceded by the bowler in 9 matches?
questions.solution:
Total runs conceded by bowler in 5 matches = 5 × 45 = 225

⇒ Total runs conceded by bowler in other 4 matches = 4 × 15.75 = 63

⇒ Total runs conceded by bowler in 9 matches = 225 + 63 = 288

⇒ Average runs conceded by the bowler in 9 matches = 288/9 = 32

∴ The average runs conceded by the bowler in 9 matches is 32

questions.question: 80 litre mixture of milk and water contains 10% milk. How much milk (in litres) must be added to make water percentage in the mixture as 80%?
questions.solution:
Given: 80L mixture of milk and water

⇒ Milk present in the mixture = (10/100) × 80 = 8L

Let the amount of milk to be added be a

Now, we want the milk percent in the mixture = 20%

⇒ [(8 + a)/(80 + a)] × 100 = 20

⇒ 5(8 + a) = 80 + a

⇒ 40 + 5a = 80 + a

⇒ 4a = 40

∴ a = 10

questions.question: By which least number should 5000 be divided so that it becomes a perfect square?
questions.solution:
Let’s calculate all the factors by prime factorization method

⇒ 5000 = 2 × 5 × 5 × 10 × 10

Here, 5 × 5 × 10 × 10 = 2500 is a perfect square

So, required number = 5000/2500 = 2

∴ the correct option is 1)

questions.question: A chord of length 60 cm is at a distance of 16 cm from the centre of a circle. What is the radius (in cm) of the circle?
questions.solution:
Let the chord be AB and O be the centre of the circle

The perpendicular bisector on AB be OC.

Now, ∆AOC is a right angled triangle.

So, AO² = OC² + AC²

⇒ AO² = 16² + 30²

⇒ AO = 34 cm

⇒ Radius = AO = 34 cm

∴ the correct option is 2)

questions.question: 15% of total time is spent on quality check and this time is equally taken from all other processes. So what will be the new sectorial angle (in degrees) made by total time of seats and glass?
questions.solution:
Since, 15% of total time is spent on quality check.

Percentage of time taken for quality check from all other processes

= 15/6 = 2.5%

⇒ Percent of time taken by seats = 6 - 2.5 = 3.5%

⇒ Percent of time taken by glass = 8 - 2.5 = 5.5%

⇒ Percent of time taken by both seats and glass = 3.5 + 5.5 = 9%

Required sectorial angle = (9/100) × (360) = 32.4°

∴ the correct option is 2.

questions.question: A sum of Rs.400 becomes Rs. 448 at simple interest in 2 years. In how many years will the sum of Rs. 550 amounts to Rs. 682 at the same rate?
questions.solution:
Initial Principal = Rs.400, Initial Amount = Rs. 448

Time period = 2 years

⇒ Amount = P + (P × R × T)/100

⇒ 448 = 400 + (400 × R × 2)/100

⇒ 448 – 400 = 8R

⇒ 48 = 8R

⇒ R = 48/8 = 6%

New Principal = Rs. 550, New Amount = Rs. 682

⇒ Amount = P + (P × R × T)/100

⇒ 682 = 550 + (550 × 6 × T)/100

⇒ 132 = 33 T

⇒ T = 4

∴ the correct option is 4)

The marked price of an article is 20% more than its cost price. If 5% discount is given on the marked price, then what is the profit percentage?
questions.solution:
Let the cost price be a

⇒ The marked price of article = a + (20/100)a = 1.2a

⇒ Discount on marked price = 5%

⇒ Selling price = 1.2a – (5/100)1.2a

⇒ Selling price = 1.2a – 0.06a

⇒ Selling price = 1.14a

So, profit percent = [(1.14a – a)/a] × 100

⇒ 14%

∴ the correct option is 2)

questions.question:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1598e6fa862fd3e40a2093e99847bdb1ac227ac72ac39af163cf83065fbf6afe.png]
questions.solution:
Circumradius = (AB × BC × AC)/ 4 × (1/2) × BC × AE

⇒ Circumradius = 15/ 2

⇒ Circumradius = 7.5 cm

∴ Answer is 7.5 cm

**ALTERNATE METHOD**:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1598e6fa862fd3e40a2093e99847bdb1ac227ac72ac39af163cf83065fbf6afe.png] 

Join BD

Also, ∠DBA = ∠CEA = 90°

So, ΔABD = ΔAEC are similar triangles

⇒ AD/AB = AC/AE

⇒ AD/10 = 6/4

Since, AD = 2 × circumradius

questions.question: A bus starts running with the initial speed of 21 km/hr and its speed increases every hour by 3 km/hr. How many hours will it take to cover a distance of 252 km?
questions.solution:
Given: initial speed (a) = 21 km/hr

⇒ Increase in speed every hour (d) = 3 km/hr

This is an A.P. with initial number (a) = 21 and difference (d) = 3

Also, the sum of AP = n/2[2a + (n – 1)d]

⇒ 252 = n/2[2 × 21 + (n – 1)3]

⇒ 3n² + 39n - 504 = 0

⇒ n = 8, -21

Since, number of hours can’t be negative

∴ the correct option is 3)

questions.question: If tanA = 1/2 and tanB = 1/3, then what is the value of tan(2A + B)?
questions.solution:
We know that

tan(A + B) = [(tanA + tanB)/1 - tanAtanB]

So, tan(2A + B) = [(tan2A +tanB)/1 - tan2AtanB]

Also, tan2A = 2tanA/(1 – tan²A)

⇒ tan2A = 2(1/2)/(1 – (1/2)²)

⇒ tan2A = 4/3

⇒ tan(2A + B) = [(4/3 + 1/3)/1 - (4/3)(1/3)]

⇒ tan(2A + B) = (5/3)/(5/9) = 3

⇒ tan(2A + B) = 3

∴ the correct option is 2)

Radius of cylinder is increased by 25%

Then, the new radius becomes = 1.25r

Since, previous volume = present volume

⇒ πr²h = π(1.25r)²H

⇒ h = (1.25)²H

⇒ h = 1.5625H

⇒ H = h/1.5625

⇒ H = 0.64h

= 0.36 x 100

= 36.
